cells.gaps: Outside the capital the only system is a pilot: the Real Property Tax Expansion pilot in Grand Bassa, Margibi and Nimba (June 2026). Monrovia City Corporation's Ewallie platform bills businesses in the capital, and three neighbouring local governments say they have no access to it. No plan is stated and nothing dated inside the twelve months is a change.
cells.note: Monrovia, the capital, bills businesses on Ewallie (LBR-008) and a property tax pilot prints bills in Grand Bassa (LBR-004, LBR-005): the capital and a pilot, stage 2. Stage 3 needs a system past its pilot and live outside the capital.
